title: Versioned cross-CLI protocol envelope
description: The frame every logical message travels in (D-007 Section 8.5). Codex and Claude never talk to each other; every message crosses the supervisor as one of these, UTF-8, one JSON object per line. payload_digest is recomputed on receipt and a mismatch refuses the message before anything acts on it.

protocol_version.description: A mismatch fails closed: the supervisor stops when installed behavior no longer matches the accepted capability manifest.

message_id.description: Processed idempotently. Re-delivery with identical content is a duplicate and is skipped; reuse with DIFFERENT content is refused.

correlation_id.description: Ties a decision to the exact checkpoint and evidence digests it reviewed.

sequence.description: Per-producer, contiguous. Gaps and reordering are refused, never inferred.

payload_digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON encoding of `payload`.

payload.description: Payload shape is governed by the schema named in payload_type.
